rules: Rust code compiles to wasm32-unknown-unknown target
Use #![allow(dead_code)] for wasm-bindgen exports not visible to Rust compiler
Use #[allow(dead_code)] for public functions not yet called from Tauri commands
Build must use C:\TauriBuild (ASCII path) due to MinGW linker limitation with accented paths
Never import @skynet/inference-runtime directly — frontend uses MockAgentModel inline
Next.js pages use proxy pattern: fetch /api/inference which delegates to inference-server.mjs
next.config.js must keep IgnorePlugin for @node-llama-cpp/* and @reflink/*
Use vi.stubGlobal() + vi.unstubAllGlobals() for mocking WebTransport/RTCPeerConnection
Prefer vi.mock() over vi.doMock() for module-level mocks
